thresholds.source: Laboratory-measured compensability limit for young, healthy adults, reported at about 30-31 C (Vecellio et al.)
thresholds.does_not_mean: A limit for the elderly or the working population, which is lower

thresholds.source: Theoretical upper limit of human heat dissipation (Sherwood & Huber 2010; used by Raymond et al. 2020)
